non_blocking.suggestion: The ADR widens the hidden-reasoning term to all hidden reasoning ('plus unstreamed hidden reasoning (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17)'). The owning document's Settlement bound limits it to 'hidden reasoning above C on `gemini` and `ollama`', because on Anthropic Messages C is written to `max_tokens`, 'which also bounds thinking'. The ADR's bound is looser, so it is still safe, but it should say 'hidden reasoning above C on `gemini` and `ollama`'. Also, 'pack 8.9 omits both extra terms (OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15)' credits OQ-15 with both terms. OQ-15 covers the extra-attempt term and OQ-17 covers hidden reasoning, so write '(OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15, OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17)'.

The new clause 'assumes the Route has exactly one upstream leg and no `composition` (proposed validation code: OQ-ai-llm-gateway-16)' makes the decoder's Upstream unique before onRoute. It does not contradict the owning document. However, OQ-ai-llm-gateway-16 option (a) in the owning document does not yet list this code, and its Surface decoder section does not state the assumption. When the owning document is next revised, add the constraint to both places so the two documents register the same code.
